question.text: The order of the differential equation of the family of curves <math><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow></mfrac><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></math> where <math><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>d</mi></math> are arbitrary constants is

solution.text:
Given equation is
y=Asin⁡bx+3dx
which has 3 arbitrary constants, hence the order of the differential equation will be 3.
